description: Before installing an MCP server or npm package, audit it: does it run an INSTALL SCRIPT (arbitrary code execution at `npm i`), is it abandoned, does it ship a repository and license, weekly downloads, provenance — with a safe/caution/avoid verdict. ~11% of audited MCP servers run install scripts. Free.

package.description: npm package name of the MCP server, e.g. @scope/name

name: mcp_check_server
title: Audit an MCP server before installing
